name: stat
title: Stat
description: Headline numbers and facts of a page: StatGrid (as many columns as fit, each at least 192px, 16px apart), Stat (a card's hairline edge, 16px in) of StatLabel (13px, grey), StatValue (22px, text-display, tabular) and StatDetail (a line in the faintest grey); and FactList, a row of Facts under a page's title, each its label small and grey over its value, 24px apart, wrapping where narrow (a description list).
